services.name: Milwaukee History Kayak Tour
services.desc: In partnership with Milwaukee Kayak Company. Join us for a paddle through history as we explore downtown Milwaukee and our rivers by kayak. Steve Schaffer, Archivist, and Michael Barera, Assistant Archivist and Digitization Specialist, from the Milwaukee County Historical Society, will guide us on our rivers and share historical insights while we learn about the famous names, buildings and bridges that made Milwaukee, MILWAUKEE. Our History Tours are paddled at a slower pace, suitable for most skill levels.
